ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this; you can see it there.
servicesQ: How do I add or change a service, its price or picture?
servicesA: Open the {salon} tab, then “{services}”. Tap “{add}”, or tap a service to change its name, minutes, price or picture, then tap “{save}”. Switch a service off to stop bookings for it.
hoursQ: How do I set my opening hours?
hoursA: {salon} tab › “{hours}”. Switch off your weekly off day, set when you open and close on the other days, and tap “{save}”. Barbers' hours must fit inside these.
closedDaysQ: How do I close the salon for a festival or holiday?
closedDaysA: {salon} › “{closed}”. Pick the date under “{closeOn}” and tap Close. Anything already booked that day must be moved or cancelled first; “{openAgain}” undoes it.
addBarbersQ: How do I add a barber?
addBarbersA: {salon} tab › “{barbers}” › “{add}”, and type his name. If you cut hair yourself too, tap “{addMe}”. Then tap him to give his services and weekly hours.
barberHoursQ: How do I set a barber's hours and services?
barberHoursA: {salon} tab › “{barbers}”, then tap the barber. Under “{weekly}” set his shifts (or tap “{useSalon}”) and tap “{saveHours}”. Under “{services}”, tick his services and tap “{saveServices}”.
inviteBarberQ: How does a barber sign in on his own phone?
inviteBarberA: {salon} tab › “{barbers}”, tap the barber, and under “{signIn}” type his mobile number and tap “{invite}”. He signs in to Clozest Partner with that number and accepts; then he sees his own bookings.
inviteHelperQ: How do I add a helper who runs the day with me?
inviteHelperA: {salon} › “{team}” › “{invite}”. Type their mobile number and tap “{send}”; they accept when they sign in to Clozest Partner with that number. You can let them add walk-ins there too.
rulesQ: How do I set how soon and how far ahead customers can book?
rulesA: {salon} tab › “{rules}”. “{notice}”: customers can't book a time closer than this. “{ahead}”: from 1 to 30 days. Then tap “{save}”.
newBookingQ: How does a new booking reach me?
newBookingA: A new online booking shows at once on {today} and under {bookings} › “{comingUp}”, and as a message under the bell on {today}. With booking notifications on, this phone also gets a notification.
notificationsQ: How do I get a notification for every booking?
notificationsA: On {more}, switch on “{row}” (or tap “{turnOn}” when {today} asks) and allow notifications. On iPhone, first tap Share › Add to Home Screen and open Clozest Partner from there.
startCodeA: Every booking has a 4-digit code on the customer's booking screen; it shows they are really here. When they come, tap the booking on {today}, tap “{start}” and type the code. It opens 15 minutes before the time; if they can't show the code, the owner or a helper can start it anyway.
walkInQ: How do I add a walk-in customer?
walkInA: On {today}, tap “{add}”. Tick what they want, choose a barber who is free, and tap Start now. If it says walk-ins need the owner's OK, the owner turns it on in {salon} › “{team}”. Everyone busy? Tap a busy barber to keep his next free time for the customer.
doneEarlyQ: The customer finished early or didn't come: what do I do?
doneEarlyA: Tap the booking on {today}. “{doneEarly}” frees the rest of its time for others. “{noShow}” opens 10 minutes after the booked time: the time is freed, and a customer who booked online gets a missed-booking strike.
reassignQ: How do I give a booking to another barber, or cancel it?
reassignA: Tap the booking on {today}. “{give}” shows only barbers who do these services and are free then. “{cancel}” asks for a reason, which is sent to the customer.
pauseQ: Too busy: how do I stop online bookings for a while?
pauseA: On {today}, tap “{pause}”, and choose “{hour}”, “{rest}” or “{tomorrow}”. Bookings already made and walk-ins carry on. Tap “{resume}” to open again.
breaksQ: How do I add a break?
breaksA: On {today}, tap “{add}”, pick the day and the time, and tap “{save}”: customers can't book that time. A barber can add his own breaks for today or tomorrow, up to 4 hours a day.
leaveQ: How do I give a barber leave for whole days?
leaveA: On {today}, tap “{add}”, choose “{leave}” and the barber, pick the first and last day, and tap “{save}”. Anything already booked in those days must be given to another barber or cancelled first.
offersQ: How do I run a discount offer?
offersA: {salon} › “{offers}” › “{add}”. Pick the discount, the services and the days (or only some hours), tap “{preview}”, then “{publish}”: your past customers get a message at once.
ratingsQ: Where do I see customers' ratings?
ratingsA: {salon} › “{ratings}”. Customers can rate a visit after an online booking ends; they get a message asking them to. Customers see “New” until you have 5 ratings.
shareQ: How do I share my salon with customers?
shareA: {salon} › “{share}”. Tap “{whatsapp}” to send your salon's link, or “{poster}” for the counter poster with its QR code. Whoever opens the link sees your salon and can book you on Clozest.
customersSeeQ: What do customers see about my salon?
customersSeeA: “{info}” shows your opening hours, services with prices, and offers, as customers see them. Only the owner changes them, in the {salon} tab.
subscriptionQ: What does Clozest cost, and how do I pay?
subscriptionA: It's free for 30 days from the day our field team approves your salon, then a monthly fee. Only the owner pays, under {more} › “{subscription}” (“{autoPay}”, or pay once); helpers and barbers pay nothing.
detailsQ: How do I change my salon's name or details?
detailsA: {salon} tab › “{details}” (or “{edit}” on the salon card in {more}). Once your salon is verified, we first send a code to your phone. Our field team checks the change again; your salon stays live meanwhile.
photosQ: How do I change the salon's photos or video?
photosA: {salon} tab › “{photos}”: your photo, the shop front and the salon video. Once your salon is verified, we first send a code to your phone.
licenceQ: How do I add or change the trade licence?
licenceA: {salon} tab › “{licence}” › “{pick}”. We check it against your salon's name and address, and tell you under the bell when it's accepted and before it ends.
addressQ: How do I change the salon's address?
addressA: {salon} tab › “{details}”. Once our field team has checked your salon, the address can't simply be typed over: tap “{request}”, and the field team checks the new address first.
phoneQ: How do I change my mobile number?
phoneA: Open {more} › “{mobile}” › “{change}”. We send a code to the new number and one to your current number or email; type both. Your salon, bookings and history stay with your account.
emailQ: How do I change my email?
emailA: Open {more} › “{email}” › “{change}”. First we send an SMS code to your phone to check it's you, then a code to the new email.
languageQ: How do I change the app's language?
languageA: At the top of {more}, tap the “{language}” button and pick yours. On a shared phone each person keeps their own language.
handoverQ: How do I hand over the salon to someone else?
handoverA: At the bottom of {more}, tap “{handOver}”, type their mobile number and tap “{send}”. When they accept in Clozest Partner they become the owner and you leave the salon; its bookings, team and listing stay.
closeQ: How do I close the salon for good?
closeA: At the bottom of {more}, tap “{close}”. Every upcoming online booking is cancelled and the customers are told, and your team loses access. It can't be undone: if someone else will run it, hand it over instead.
leaveSalonQ: How do I leave this salon?
leaveSalonA: At the bottom of {more}, tap “{leave}” and confirm. You won't see this salon's bookings any more; the owner can add you again.
regVideoQ: What should the salon video show?
regVideoA: Start outside: the board with the salon's name and the entrance. Then walk in and turn slowly to show the chairs, mirrors and waiting area. Hold the phone sideways, lights on; no need to talk. Only our field team sees it.
regLicenceQ: Which paper counts as a trade licence?
regLicenceA: The trade licence for your salon from GHMC or your municipality, exactly as you got it, with its number and dates in the photo. It is optional: without it, customers just don’t see the “Licensed” badge.
regPinA: On your salon’s door. Stand inside the salon and tap “{useLocation}”, or drag the pin onto your door. Customers nearby find you by it, and our field team checks it on their visit.
regAfterA: Our field team calls you to fix a time, visits the salon and switches it on. Customers can book once it’s approved. Meanwhile you can add your barbers.
regSentBackQ: The field team sent it back: what do I do?
regSentBackA: Open the last step, “{review}”: it shows what they asked for, with a link to the step to fix. Fix it, then submit again.
joinWhereQ: My owner invited me: where is the invitation?
joinWhereA: Sign in with the number your owner invited. The invitation shows on the first screen when you open the app: tap “{accept}”. Not there? Ask your owner to check the number he typed.
joinWrongQ: I joined the wrong salon: how do I leave?
joinWrongA: Tap “{leave}” on your first screen (or under {more} once the salon is live). Then accept the right salon’s invitation.
joinOwnerNotOnQ: My owner isn’t on Clozest yet: what do I do?
joinOwnerNotOnA: Your owner first registers the salon in the Clozest Partner app, then invites your number. Until then there is nothing to join. Own a salon yourself? Register it from the first screen.
kSetupQ: How do I put all my products in the app?
kSetupA: On the {counter}, tap “{setUp}”. Photograph your product list page by page (“{photograph}”), check each line, count what is on the shelf and take the photos asked for. When everything is in, tap “{finish}”.
kAddProductQ: How do I add one product?
kAddProductA: {products} tab › “{add}”. Scan or type its barcode, give its name and price and how many are on the shelf, then save.
kCountQ: The stock in the app is wrong: how do I correct it?
kCountA: {products} tab, open the product and tap “{count}”. Type how many are on the shelf now and save. When new stock comes in, tap “{came}” instead.
kNoBarcodeQ: How do I bill an item with no barcode, or when the camera won’t scan?
kNoBarcodeA: On the {counter}, tap “{notInList}”, type what it is and its price, then “{addToBill}”. If the camera won’t scan, type the digits under the barcode in “{scan}” instead.
kUpiQ: The UPI payment didn’t come: what do I do?
kUpiA: Check your own UPI app first. If the money didn’t come, take cash and tap “{cash}”. For a bill already saved, open it under {bills} and tap “{change}”.
kReturnQ: How do I take back a returned item?
kReturnA: {bills} tab, open the bill and tap “{back}”. Enter how much came back, then “{save}”. The stock goes back up; on a khata bill it comes off the khata first.
kKhataQ: How do I change a customer’s khata limit?
kKhataA: {khata} tab, open the customer and tap “{edit}”. Set “{limit}” (or “{noLimit}”) and save.
kHelperQ: How do I add a helper?
kHelperA: Open {more} › “{team}” › “{invite}”: type their mobile number and send. They sign in to the Clozest Partner app with that number and accept.
kLicencesQ: Where do I add my FSSAI or trade licence?
kLicencesA: Open {more} › “{licences}”. Take a clear photo of the whole licence, or upload its PDF. We check it and say here if anything needs fixing.
